patterns.note: The hero section features an oversized, multi-line typographic logo that acts as a dynamic overlay for a full-bleed video background.
Primary headings and section titles utilize an extremely large, condensed, bold sans-serif typeface, often spanning the full width of the viewport, creating a strong, almost architectural presence.
A high-contrast palette of bright yellow, deep blue, and black is used to define distinct content blocks and highlight key typographic elements, creating visual separation and impact.
The oversized hero text 'FIGUREFILM' dynamically scales down and moves upwards as the user scrolls, transforming into a compact, sticky header that remains visible at the top of the page.
Content sections are introduced with full-width, solid color backgrounds (e.g., deep blue) and large, bold typographic titles that serve as the primary visual anchor for the section.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a scroll-triggered animation where the main title text transitions from an expansive, viewport-filling display to a compact, sticky navigation bar. This effect is layered over a continuously playing full-bleed video background.

Large, impactful typographic elements are used as primary visual anchors for sections, often spanning the full width of the viewport and set against solid, contrasting color blocks to create strong visual hierarchy.
A minimalist navigation system is initially integrated into the hero's typographic layout and then transforms into a persistent, compact header after the initial scroll depth is reached.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, condensed sans-serif headings (~8-10x body) with small, uppercase mono-spaced labels and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with minimal use of subtle rounding primarily for small interactive elements like buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and expansive in the hero and main section titles, creating a sense of grandeur, transitioning to a more balanced density in the footer and secondary content areas.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold, almost brutalist use of oversized typography as primary visual elements, often spanning the full viewport. The dynamic transformation of the hero title into a sticky header on scroll is a unique and impactful execution, creating a strong brand identity through motion and scale rather than traditional imagery.
